root_cause.text: The cleanup path in xe_vm_madvise_ioctl when check_bo_args_are_sane() fails jumps to madv_fini, skipping the deallocation of the previously allocated vmas array, leading to a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the goto target from madv_fini to the new free_vmas label, which performs kfree(madvise_range.vmas) and sets it to NULL, ensuring proper cleanup.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The cleanup path in xe_vm_madvise_ioctl when check_bo_args_are_sane() fails jumps to madv_fini, skipping the deallocation of the previously allocated vmas array, leading to a memory leak.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes the goto target from madv_fini to the new free_vmas label, which performs kfree(madvise_range.vmas) and sets it to NULL, ensuring proper cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixed error path in xe_vm_madvise_ioctl to properly free allocated vmas before finalization.
intent_record.what: Changed the goto target in the error branch of xe_vm_madvise_ioctl from 'madv_fini' to 'free_vmas'.
intent_record.how: Upon a failure condition (related to madvise_range.num_vmas and args->atomic.val), the code now jumps to the 'free_vmas' label instead of 'madv_fini', ensuring that allocated vmas are freed before continuing with finalization, preventing a resource leak or inconsistent state.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add label to allow error paths to free allocated vmas array, preventing memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added a label 'free_vmas:' before the existing kfree(madvise_range.vmas) and NULL assignment, providing a target for goto jumps from error paths.
intent_record.how: Other parts of the function can now use 'goto free_vmas;' to ensure madvise_range.vmas is freed and set to NULL, avoiding duplicate cleanup code and potential memory leaks on error.

grouping_result.intent: Add label to allow error paths to free allocated vmas array, preventing memory leak.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix memory leak in xe_vm_madvise_ioctl by ensuring allocated vmas are freed on error paths.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the memory leak vulnerability by ensuring the allocated vmas array is freed on error paths, which is exactly the root cause described.

candidates.rationale: When check_bo_args_are_sane() fails, this goto jumps directly to madv_fini, which is after the kfree(madvise_range.vmas) call, thereby skipping deallocation and causing a memory leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This goto jumps directly to madv_fini when check_bo_args_are_sane() fails, skipping the kfree(madvise_range.vmas) that deallocates the allocated vmas array, causing a memory leak.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit dff547e137be2f36c6c4d77172a03a54a38230d3
Author: Thomas Hellström <thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Fri Dec 19 12:33:11 2025 +0100

    drm/xe/uapi: Extend the madvise functionality to support foreign pagemap placement for svm
    
    Use device file descriptors and regions to represent pagemaps on
    foreign or local devices.
    
    The underlying files are type-checked at madvise time, and
    references are kept on the drm_pagemap as long as there is are
    madvises point
bic_trace_step.reason: The diff shows that in xe_vm_madvise_ioctl, when check_bo_args_are_sane() fails, the error path jumps to 'madv_fini' (line 487-488) which only calls xe_madvise_details_fini() but does NOT free madvise_range.vmas. The kfree(madvise_range.vmas) at line 485 is placed before the label and is therefore skipped. This results in a memory leak of the vmas array allocated by get_vmas().
